CallLogRecord.title: CallLogRecord
CallLogRecord.description: Represents an outgoing or incoming call log entry with Verified Business Caller ID telemetry, CRM sync state, and Gemini AI post-call summary.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated user owning this call log.

phoneNumber.description: Normalized phone number of the counterparty.

contactName.description: Display name resolved from contacts, CRM, or verified business directory.

direction.description: Direction or outcome of the call.

timestampMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds when the call started.

durationSeconds.description: Duration of the call in seconds.

callingMode.description: Whether the call used the Verified Business Identity route or Personal route.

verifiedCallerIdStatus.description: Truthful Verified Business Caller ID status at the time of the call.

verifiedLegalNameUsed.description: Locked official business legal name presented on the call.

crmSyncStatus.description: Synchronization status with the CRM contact record.

crmContactId.description: Linked CRM contact record document ID.

aiSummaryOverview.description: Concise AI-generated summary of the call conversation.

aiDiscussionPoints.description: Key discussion points extracted by Gemini after the call.

aiActionItems.description: Follow-up action items extracted by Gemini after the call.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when record was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when record was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

CrmContactRecord.title: CrmContactRecord
CrmContactRecord.description: Customer Relationship Management contact record automatically updated with call logs, verified caller ID metrics, and AI call summaries.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated user owning this CRM contact.

phoneNumber.description: Normalized phone number linked to call logs.

totalCalls.description: Cumulative number of calls logged with this contact.

verifiedOutboundCallsCount.description: Count of outgoing calls placed with Verified Business Caller ID.

lastInteractionTimestamp.description: Epoch milliseconds of the most recent logged call.

latestAiSummary.description: Most recent AI post-call summary attached to this contact.

openActionItems.description: Pending follow-up action items from AI call summarization.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when contact was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when contact was updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

VerifiedBusinessIdentity.title: VerifiedBusinessIdentity
VerifiedBusinessIdentity.description: Authoritative locked business identity record separated from ordinary editable profile fields.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated business owner.

registrationNumberMasked.description: Protected/masked GSTIN or Udyam registration identifier.

verifiedLegalName.description: Official legal business name from authoritative record.

verifiedTradeName.description: Independently verified trade name if applicable.

applicantAuthorized.description: Whether applicant authority to represent the business was verified.

lockStatus.description: Current Official Business Identity Lock state.

outboundNumber.description: Authorized outbound phone number linked to the verified business identity.

outboundNumberVerified.description: Whether right-to-use for the outbound phone number was independently verified.

callerIdProviderStatus.description: Carrier/provider approval state for Verified Business Caller ID.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of initial lock creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last verification transition.

IdentityAuditEvent.title: IdentityAuditEvent
IdentityAuditEvent.description: Append-only security audit trail for business identity verification, re-verification, activation, and suspension events.

eventType.description: Audit transition type (e.g., IDENTITY_LOCKED, REVERIFICATION_STARTED, ACTIVATION_BLOCKED).

matchedLegalName.description: Verified legal name associated with the event.

failureReason.description: Detailed rejection or suspension reason if any.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp of the audit event.

/users/{userId}/call_logs/{callId}.description: Per-user call logs with Verified Business Caller ID status, duration, and AI post-call summaries.

/users/{userId}/crm_contacts/{contactId}.description: Per-user CRM contact records synced automatically on call completion.

/users/{userId}/business_identity/{docId.description: Per-user Official Business Identity Lock state and Verified Outbound Caller ID status.

/users/{userId}/identity_audit_logs/{aud.description: Per-user immutable audit log of identity verification and caller-ID state transitions.
